name: google-messages-for-desktop
description: Google Messages for web as a desktop app (Electron shell from OrangeDrangon; sms/tel protocol compose)
copyright: Copyright Google Messages For Desktop contributors; Electron shell based on OrangeDrangon/android-messages-desktop (MIT)

scripts.dev: npm run build:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron --enable-source-maps ./app/background.js
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux --publish never
